facts.assertion: Planning Data reports 37,666 Brownfield land records from 354 data providers.
The Brownfield land collector last ran on 23 July 2026 and new data was last found on 22 July 2026.
Planning Data labels Brownfield land origin as all data from authoritative sources.
Planning Data describes Brownfield land as suitable for informing policy and identifying sites with development potential, not as a site-allocation dataset.
Planning Data reports 2,916 Brownfield site boundary records from 5 providers.
Planning Data explicitly labels Brownfield site as an experimental dataset.
The Brownfield site collector last ran on 26 July 2026 while new data was last found on 19 December 2025.
Planning Data says Brownfield site data was created by MHCLG and will be replaced with authoritative-source data when available.
Planning Data reports 1,050 Local plan records from 65 providers.
The Local plan collector last ran and found new data on 24 July 2026.
Planning Data says the Local plan dataset contains separate rows for current, emerging and historical plans.
Planning Data says Local plan data is MHCLG-created pending replacement with authoritative-source data.
Planning Data reports 364 Local plan boundary records from one provider.
The Local plan boundary collector last ran on 24 July 2026 and last found new data on 18 March 2026.
Planning Data says Local plan boundary data is MHCLG-created pending replacement with authoritative sources.
Planning Data reports zero Local plan document records, zero providers and no collector attempt.
Planning Data reports 379 Local authority records and a collector run on 27 July 2026.
Planning Data reports 337 Local Planning Authority boundaries and a collector run on 24 July 2026.
The local-plan specification requires local-plan boundary geometry as a polygon or multipolygon and prefers WGS84.
Dataset currentness, authoritative-source labels and experimental status are source-quality evidence only and do not prove candidate future-growth allocation membership.
